Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have from this one-sided game. Up next is a big one. South Africa Women have the ticket to the finale on the line as a win against Bangladesh Women will take them through to the knockouts. The match will begin shortly at 10.30 pm IST (2 pm GMT). You can switch tabs and join us for all the updates. Cheers!

Heather Knight, the skipper of England Women, says it feels really good to go in the semis unbeaten and take this kind of momentum with them. On Danni Wyatt finding some form, Heathe replies that a score like this was always around the horizon and when she is clicking the team plays far better and there couldn't be a better moment for her to regain her form. Adds that Lauren Bell was given rest today and she feels that players like Natalie Sciver and Katherine Sciver adapted to the conditions well and it massively benefitted the team.

Nida Dar, the stand-in skipper of Pakistan Women, says that they are disappointed with the way they ended their campaign. Admits that they lack strength in their batting and they have to learn from these games. Hopes that they will take some positives from this tournament. Mentions that it's the best time for the new crop to come and take the team forward. On becoming the leading wicket-taker in Women's T20Is, Dar replies that it's a milestone for her and she always wants to do the best for her team.

Katherine Brunt is the Player of the Match for her sensational knock. Says that the surface was good at the start and the spinners were getting some purchase on this but they did not let the Pakistan bowlers settle. Adds that Sophia Dunkley and Alice Capsey have been tremendous so far in the tournament and the knock from Danni Wyatt would do a lot of good to her and the team. On the team's fielding, she said that the team has fielded well and grabbed their chances in the field. She closes by saying it was a really good game to win and now they will be looking forward to the semis.
Presentation coming up...

England Women will be thrilled with this dominating victory. They registered the biggest win in this tournament (in terms of runs) and could not have asked for a better last game before the semis. Danni Wyatt and Katherine Brunt were struggling in this edition but both found some rhythm and ticked all the boxes for the English team.

Onslaught with the bat and domination with the ball - England Women have demolished Pakistan Women and will head into the knockouts with all the momentum behind them. It was a power-packed batting show from the likes of Danni Wyatt, Natalie Sciver and Amy Jones as they guided England Women to the highest-ever total in ICC Women's T20 World Cup. Pakistan Women's chase never got going as they were blown away early in the Powerplay. It was a steady procession of wickets and apart from a brief resistance towards the end, there was nothing substantial in their batting.

OUT! STUMPED! Sophie Ecclestone spears it very full and wide outside off, Nashra Sandhu advances down the track and tries to squeeze it out. Misses and Amy Jones does the rest. England Women win by 114 runs.
Commentary.Howout: st Amy Jones b Sophie Ecclestone

Commentary.Commentary: Slower one on off, Fatima Sana punches this off the back foot to extra cover for a single.
Flighted outside off, Nashra Sandhu pushes this to mid off for a quick single.
Quicker around off, Nashra Sandhu taps this to short cover.
Fuller around off, Fatima Sana drives this to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR BYES! Tossed up and angling away from the stumps, Fatima Sana comes up with the big heave but fails to connect. The keeper misses this too and it runs for a boundary.
Back of a length on top of middle, Fatima Sana pulls this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Nashra Sandhu is the number 10 batter.
Appeal for a run out...

OUT! Run out! Freya bowls it on a length around off, Tuba hammers it past mid off and Brunt does well to make the stop near the fence. She recovers from her dive and then sends a flat throw to the bowler. The bails are taken off and the Tuba is short of the crease. The umpire though wants to check whether it was a clean stop from Katherine Brunt. The replays show that Tuba Hassan thought that it went for a boundary and was outside the crease. Poor!

SIX! That's gone to long on and over long on for a maximum. Fuller around off, Tuba Hassan clubs this to long one fence for a maximum. Katherine Brunt collects this at long on but the momentum takes her over the fence and six has been signaled.
On a length around middle, Tuba Hassan looks to play across the line but ends up pushing it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Slower one, a full toss just around the waist, Tuba Hassan slogs this towards the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary. It's not called a no ball.
On a length angling in, Tuba Hassan opens up in her stance and smashes it to mid off.
Fuller outside off, Fatima Sana looks to chip this over the off side but misses out.
Short in length on middle, Fatima Sana taps this to cover-point for nothing.
Fuller one darted outside off, Tuba Hassan cuts this to backward point for a single.
No ball! Full toss above waist height and Fatima Sana lofts this towards sweeper cover for a single. No ball signalled. Free Hit coming up.
Full toss outside off, Fatima Sana walks down the track and smashes this to mid on.
Toe crusher this time and all Fatima Sana could do is block this out.
Fuller, close to the blockhole, Fatima Sana pushes this to short mid-wicket.
Fuller around off, Fatima Sana drives this to mid off for a single. The fielder does well to stop a certain boundary.
Back of the hand delivery, fuller and on off, Tuba Hassan drives this to sweeper cover for a single.

Appeal for a run out! Back of a length around middle, Tuba Hassan cuts this to short third man and sets off for a run. She is sent back as the fielder throws the ball to the keeper. Amy Jones breaks the stumps and appeals. It's referred upstairs and the replays find that Tuba has made it with a dive.
Touch fuller outside off, Tuba Hassan pokes at this but gets beaten.
On a length outside off, Fatima Sana gives it a shimmy as she cuts this to sweeper cover for a single.
On a length angling in towards the batter, Fatima Sana blocks this out for nothing.
Freya Davies would love to pick a wicket or two in this spell.
Flighted outside off, Tuba Hassan drills this over mid off for a couple more to end the 16th over.
Flatter outside off, Fatima Sana cuts this to point for a single.
Fuller around off, Tuba Hassan pushes this to mid on for a single.

FOUR! She hit one in the same direction and it went for two but this time she finds the connection well and it has travelled for a boundary. Arm delivery outside off, Tuba Hassan chips this over covers for a boundary.
Off-break outside off, Tuba Hassan looks to cut but misses out.
Tossed up outside off, Tuba Hassan gives it the long handle as she lofts this over covers for a couple of runs.
Charlotte Dean to bowl out now...
Flighted around middle, Fatima Sana tries to flick but misses. It deflects off her pads to the leg side.
Loopy delivery outside off, Fatima Sana smashes this to short cover for nothing.
Quicker through the air and on middle, Fatima Sana blocks this out.
Tossed up around middle, Fatima Sana walks down the track and drives this to mid off.
Fuller on middle, Tuba Hassan pushes this to extra cover for a single.
Sarah Glenn would like to add more wickets to her tally.
Fuller outside off, Fatima Sana cuts this late to backward point for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Fatima Sana taps this to square leg for a single.
Fuller around middle, Tuba Hassan sweeps this towards the on side for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Fatima Sana looks to slog but fails to connect. Amy misses it too as they run a single. Bye signalled.
Tossed up outside off, Tuba Hassan nudges this to short fine leg for a single.
Flatter and drifting down leg, Tuba Hassan sweeps this to deep square leg for a couple.
Flighted around off, Tuba Hassan taps this to short mid wicket.
Charlotte Dean is back on. 2 for 13 in her two overs so far.
On a length outside off, Tuba Hassan guides this to third man for a single. 4-0-14-2, Brunt is done for the evening.
Back of a length around off, Fatima Sana tries to cut but gets an outside edge. It falls safely at short third man and they cross.
Who will face the music next? It's Tuba Hassan.

OUT! RUN OUT! Brunt serves it on a length around off, Sana taps it down to covers. Sidra Nawaz comes out of the crease in search of a run but is sent back. Natalie Sciver is quick to circle around the ball and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end before Sidra could return. The third umpire is referred and the replays find that Sidra Nawaz is way short.
FOUR! Finally, the scoreboard moves as Fatima drives this past the cover fielder for a boundary. Overpitched around off, Fatima Sana opens up her off and drives one through cover for a boundary.
Back of a length outside off, Sidra Nawaz pulls this off the bottom of her bat. It flies and falls safely to the left of the keeper. They cross. 50 up!
Fuller around off, Sidra Nawaz blocks this out.
Beauty from Sophie. Loopy and around off, drifting in, Fatima Sana gets across and tries to defend the line but it spins away to beat the bat.
Tossed up around middle, Fatima Sana drills this to mid on.
Full and wide outside off, Fatima Sana looks to slog-sweep but misses out.
Length dragged back a bit, Fatima Sana leans ahead to block this out.
Flighted outside off, Fatima Sana taps this to short cover and decides not to run.
Tossed up around middle, Sidra Nawaz pushes this gently to extra cover for a single.
On a length angling down leg, Sidra Nawaz taps this to short mid wicket for a quick single.
Sidra Nawaz walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Katherine Brunt takes the pace off this one and delivers an off cutter. It's on a length around off, and Aliya Riaz tries to heave it over the leg side. She is early into the shot and gets a top edge. The ball balloons towards short cover and Heather Knight settles underneath it.
Commentary.Howout: c Heather Knight b Katherine Brunt

Commentary.Commentary: Another wide as Katherine Brunt deviates from her line a bit. Fuller, drifting down leg, Aliya looks to flick but misses.
On a length, keeping a tad low, Aliya Riaz tries to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On a length, cramping Aliya for room, as she could just manage to push it back towards the bowler for nothing.
Wide down the leg side as Katherine Brunt looks to bend her back for this. Aliya Riaz leaves this. Wide signalled.
On a length around off, Fatima Sana taps this to extra cover for a single.
Short-pitched delivery near the temple area, Fatima Sana looks to play the upper cut but misses out.
Katherine Brunt (2-0-3-1) comes back into the attack.
FOUR! Arm delivery outside off and Aliya Riaz gets an outside edge to it, the ball travels wide of the fielder at short third man for a boundary.
Tossed up again, around middle, helped to mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, Fatima Sana drives this to sweeper cover for a single.

Drinks break. The chase is going on expected lines. Pakistan Women have lost half their side and they have not reached even 50. It's a lopsided contest and England Women are inching closer to a massive win. Fatima Sana is the new batter.

OUT! Sidra Ameen holes out! Floated delivery, full and wide outside off, Ameen gives the charge and tries to play a big shot down the ground. But the timing is not good and it's a simple catch for Katherine Brunt at long on. They are falling like nine pins now. Half the side is back in the hut.
Commentary.Howout: c Katherine Brunt b Charlotte Dean

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up outside off, Sidra Ameen looks to cut but misses.

FOUR! Loosner from Charlotte Dean and Sidra takes full advantage of it as she sweeps this for a boundary towards fine leg. Short in length down leg, Sidra Ameen sweeps this wide of short fine leg for a boundary.
Charlotte Dean is back on.
Tossed up again, outside off, Sidra Ameen plays the reverse sweep towards short third man for a single.
Tossed up right in the blockhole, Sidra Ameen digs this out back towards the bowler.
Flatter with a bit more pace to it, Aliya Riaz cuts this to backward point for a single.
Aliya Riaz is in next.

OUT! STUMPED! Flighted delivery, full and around off, Nida Dar gets tempted by the flight and runs down the track for a big shot. She swings her bat across the line but the ball spins away a bit and beats her. Amy Jones does the rest and Pakistan Women lose their fourth wicket. A day to forget for the stand-in skipper!
Commentary.Howout: st Amy Jones b Sarah Glenn

Commentary.Commentary: Flighted on off, short in length, Sidra Ameen cuts this to deep point for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Nida Dar taps this to point for a single.
Full around middle, Sidra Ameen pushes this hard to mid off and wants a single but Nida Dar refuses.
Fuller outside off, Sidra Ameen tries to work it around but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Tossed up outside off, Sidra Ameen connects the reverse sweep well as she threads it wide of short third man for a couple.
Fuller around off, Nida Dar sweeps this hard all along the ground for a single towards deep square leg.
Flighted around middle, Sidra Ameen taps it towards short mid-wicket and runs for a single.
Tossed up right near the popping crease, outside off, Sidra Ameen pushes this back to the bowler.
Sophie Ecclestone is introduced into the attack. One slip in place for the number one ranked T20I bowler in the women's section.
Quicker through the air in middle, Nida Dar pushes this back towards the bowler's right for no run to end the seventh.
Flighted outside off, Nida Dar looks to play across the line but deflects this onto her pads.
Tossed up around off, Nida Dar cuts this to short third man for nothing.
Touch fuller but flatter in trajectory, outside off, Sidra Ameen punches this to sweeper cover for a single.
Short in length around off, Nida Dar pushes this to sweeper cover for a single.
Flighted around off, Sidra Ameen hops onto her back foot and cuts this to backward point for a single.
Powerplay is done and it has been a miserable start from Pakistan Women!​ Sarah Glenn is ready to bowl with the field restriction no longer in place.
FOUR! Picked up nicely and deposited for a boundary. On a length drifting down leg, Nida Dar flicks this over the short fine leg fielder or a boundary.
On a length around middle, Nida Dar pushes this to mid on for nothing.
Length dragged back a bit outside off, Nida Dar plays her stroke early as this hits the sticker of her bat and travels to short cover. Nida looks for a single but is sent back by Sidra.
Fuller and on middle, an inswinging delivery, Nida Dar gets an inside edge onto her pads.
A bit of shape as Freya Davies darts this a bit fuller around middle, Sidra Ameen lobs this over the bowler for a single.
On a length outside off, Sidra Ameen pushes this towards extra cover.
In the channel outside off, straightening a hint, Nida is caught pushing and missing inside the line.
FOUR! Full and sliding down the leg side, Dar goes down on one knee and sweeps it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Full and around off, angling in, Dar defends off the back foot.
Nida Dar replaces Omaima Sohail at the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! Pakistan Women are falling like nine pins. Full and around middle, angling down, Omaima tries to whip it over square leg but gets a top edge. It goes to the right of short fine leg and Freya Davies secures the catch with ease. As expected, Pakistan Women are going down quickly.
Commentary.Howout: c Freya Davies b Natalie Sciver

Commentary.Commentary: Lands it on a length, around off, it's defended to covers.
Edged but short! Fuller in length and around off, shaping away, Sohail tries to drive but gets a soft edge. It goes on one bounce to the keeper.
Sidra Ameen walks out and replaces Muneeba Ali. Meanwhile, it will be Natalie Sciver replacing Katherine Brunt.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Loopy and full, around off and turning away late, Muneeba Ali goes down to play the slog-sweep but it takes the top edge. The ball flies to the left of the keeper and Amy Jones takes a simple catch yet again. Both the Pakistan Women openers are now dismissed.
Commentary.Howout: c Amy Jones b Charlotte Dean

Commentary.Commentary: Full and around middle, flicked over mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller around middle, clipped behind square leg for a single.
Loopy and full, just outside off, Ali goes down to play the slog sweep but gets an inside edge. It beats the stumps and hits the keeper on the pads.
Avances down the track and slogs it off the inner edge to deep square leg. Takes a single.
Flighted and around off, Omaima pushes it from the back foot to short mid-wicket.
Wide! Drifting down the leg side, Omaima Sohail tries to flick but misses.
Charlotte Dean replaces Freya Davies.
Mishit! Slightly short and on off, slower in pace, Muneeba stands back to pull but mistimes it off the top edge. It loops in the air and drops beside the pitch.
Drops it on a length, around middle, shaping in a bit, Muneeba Ali walks across and tries to flick but is cramped for room. Somehow keeps it out to square leg.
Angling down the leg side, Sohail tries to flick but gets an inside edge. It brushes her pads and deflects to square leg for a run.
On a length again, outside off, Sohail cuts but finds backward point.
Beaten again. Lands it on a length, around off and seaming away, Sohail tries to cut but misses.
Play and a miss! Short in length and outside off, shaping away, Omaima throws her bat at it but makes no connection.
Very full, around middle and slipping down, Muneeba leans across to flick but misses. A stifled appeal for an lbw but nothing more.
Pitches it up and around off, Muneeba drives but finds the fielder at point.
Bowls it full and wide outside off, Sohail slices it over point and collects a single.
Lands it on a length, around off, Sohail defends it from the back foot to the off side.
FOUR! Classy shot! Full in length and outside off, Omaima leans forward and crunches it through the gap at covers for a boundary.
Put down but it's a Free Hit. Fullish and on middle, Ali lofts it towards mid on where the fielder doesn't take the catch but does well to stop it from racing away. Only a run.
Full ball, around middle and angling in, Muneeba defends it ahead of her front pad to mid-wicket. It's called a no ball for cutting the side crease. Free Hit coming...
Wide! Full delivery, outside off and swinging away, Ali tries to drive but misses.
Freya Davies shares the new ball from the other end.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it towards the bowler.
Back of a length, around middle, Ali works it down to deep square leg for a single.
Stays back and eases a short ball to third man for a single.
On a length around off, Omaima defends it from the back foot to covers.
Omaima Sohail replaces Sadaf Shamas (0).

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Early strike for England Women! Short in length outside off, there to be cut, Sadaf Shamas rocks back to whack it through the line but all she manages is a thick outside edge. Amy Jones, the keeper, takes a simple catch and Pakistan Women lose their first wicket in the first over itself.
Commentary.Howout: c Amy Jones b Katherine Brunt

Commentary.Commentary: Starts by angling in a length ball around middle, it shapes away a shade as Shamas goes back and defends it to point.
